info.name: Fortis POS API v1
info.description: Organized by user type and workflow. Set baseUrl and credentials in collection or environment variables. User login and refresh save returned tokens for subsequent requests; owner logins also populate ownerAccessToken. Web authentication uses HTTP-only cookies, while desktop/mobile return bearer tokens. Platform manager requests use separate platform tokens.

item.name: 03. Business owner ? activation

request.description: Web-only owner activation. Use the redemption code and initial terminal activation details received by email. Authenticate with the preceding business owner web login; Postman sends its HttpOnly cookie automatically.

Sign in as the business owner before running owner operations. The web login sets an HttpOnly access_token cookie; Postman stores and sends it automatically to the same baseUrl. Set ownerEmail and ownerPassword first. Authenticate with the preceding business owner web login; Postman sends its HttpOnly cookie automatically.

exec: pm.test('Owner login returned a user profile', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().user).to.be.an('object'));

item.description: Register the owner if needed, then log in as the owner with the web client. Postman stores the HttpOnly cookie for the owner-only terminal activation flow.

item.name: 04. Business owner ? profile & branches

exec: pm.test('Sensitive registration data is omitted', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).not.to.have.property('pan'); pm.expect(body).not.to.have.property('documents'); });

request.description: Requires an owner access token for businessId. Multipart file fields are optional; configure local file paths. Only approved profile fields and document replacement are allowed. Do not set Content-Type manually; Postman must add its multipart boundary. Authenticate with the preceding business owner web login; Postman sends its HttpOnly cookie automatically.

exec: pm.test('Response contains changed fields without document URLs', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.businessId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('businessId')); pm.expect(body.changedFields).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(body).not.to.have.property('documents'); });

request.description: Requires an owner token or a role explicitly assigned the branches.read endpoint key. An assigned branch membership sees only that branch; a membership with no branch assignment has business-wide scope. Enable the cursor query parameter after a page returns nextCursor. Authenticate with the preceding business owner web login; Postman sends its HttpOnly cookie automatically.

exec: pm.test('Response contains branch items and cursor', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.items).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body.nextCursor === null || typeof body.nextCursor === 'string').to.eql(true); body.items.forEach((branch) => { pm.expect(branch.id).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(branch.status).to.be.oneOf(['active', 'inactive']); }); });

request.description: Returns branch profile and current terminal status/member counts. Members assigned to another branch receive 404; business-wide members can read any branch. Authenticate with the preceding business owner web login; Postman sends its HttpOnly cookie automatically.

exec: pm.test('Response contains branch and operational summary', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.branch.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('branchId')); pm.expect(body.summary.terminals).to.include.all.keys('active', 'inactive', 'maintenance', 'total'); pm.expect(body.summary.members).to.include.all.keys('active', 'inactive', 'total'); });

request.description: Platform manager only and idempotent. Creates a branch and one or more inactive terminals with cryptographically random activation codes. The active owner receives branch and terminal details by email.
